title: Battles of Batočina and Jagodina
text: The Battles of Batočina and Jagodina were several battles fought in late March–April in Batočina and Jagodina between the Serbian rebels under Karađorđe and the Dahije leader Kučuk-Alija. The Serbian rebels aimed to take Jagodina while Kučuk-Alija mustered and hired troops in the region to deal with the rebellion. The Batočina inn was besieged to stop reinforcements and led to a pursuit and destruction of a Janissary contingent at a river bank. Next, a siege of Jagodina, held by Kučuk-Alija, failed miserably due to bad weather conditions. The next attack was successful after an assault and day of shootouts in the town.
